description_en: Verifies the authenticity and consistency of a phone number, name, and ID card number against an authoritative data source. If the information is inconsistent, returns the reason for the inconsistency
description_zh: 传入手机号、姓名、身份证号，通过权威数据源验证其真实性和一致性，如果不一致，返回不一致的原因
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl mobile-3-meta-verify-intl --product-code MOBILE_3META --param-type normal --identify-num 429001000000008211 --user-name '张0' --mobile 18600001234 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Mobile3MetaVerifyIntl

parameters.help_en: The product solution code. Fixed value: MOBILE_3META
parameters.help_zh: 接入的产品方案，固定值：MOBILE_3META
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The parameter type. Valid values:

- normal: not encrypted
- md5: MD5-encrypted
parameters.help_zh:
参数类型：

- normal：不加密
- md5：md5加密
parameters.name: param_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID card number.

- If ParamType is set to normal, enter the plaintext value.
- If ParamType is set to md5, enter a 32-character lowercase MD5 string
parameters.help_zh:
身份证号

- 当paramType取值normal时，输入明文
- 当paramType取值md5时，输入32位小写md5字符串
parameters.name: identify_num

parameters.help_en:
The name.

- If ParamType is set to normal, enter the plaintext value.
- If ParamType is set to md5, enter a 32-character lowercase MD5 string
parameters.help_zh:
姓名

- 当paramType取值normal时，输入明文
- 当paramType取值md5时，输入32位小写md5字符串
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The phone number.

- If ParamType is set to normal, enter the plaintext value.
- If ParamType is set to md5, enter a 32-character lowercase MD5 string
parameters.help_zh:
手机号码。

- 当paramType取值normal时，输入明文
- 当paramType取值md5时，输入32位小写md5字符串
parameters.name: mobile
